* A persistent {@link javax.net.ssl.SSLSession} cache used by * {@link javax.net.ssl.SSLSessionContext} to share client-side SSL sessions * across processes. For example, this cache enables applications to * persist and reuse sessions across restarts. * *

The {@code SSLSessionContext} implementation converts * {@code SSLSession}s into raw bytes and vice versa. The exact makeup of the * session data is dependent upon the caller's implementation and is opaque to * the {@code SSLClientSessionCache} implementation. * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

void putSessionData(SSLSession session, byte[] sessionData)
